run.question: Search VictoriaLogs for ERROR level log messages from the 'payment-api-257' service in the 'app-257' namespace. What error codes (format VLERR-XXXX) appear in those logs?

report.summary: VictoriaLogs contains exactly one stream in the authorized window 2026-11-21T10:04:26Z to 2026-11-22T10:04:26Z: {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"}, with 7 entries in total, all ingested at 2026-11-22T10:04:15Z. Three of those entries carry level=ERROR, and each of the three ERROR entries contains a VLERR code in its message: VLERR-7291 (database connection timeout, failed to connect to primary database after 30s), VLERR-4058 (payment validation failed, invalid card number format) and VLERR-9463 (stock sync failed, external inventory API returned 503). No other VLERR codes were observed for this service, and no other service or namespace had a log stream in the window. Note that the level filter is case-sensitive: level:error matched nothing while level:ERROR returned the 3 entries.

claims.text: In the window 2026-11-21T10:04:26Z to 2026-11-22T10:04:26Z the only log stream present is {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} with 7 hits; no other service or namespace stream was returned.
A query of {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} returned 7 entries, all with _time 2026-11-22T10:04:15Z, of which 3 have level=ERROR, 1 level=WARN and 3 level=INFO.

Exactly 3 ERROR-level entries were returned for {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"}: "Database connection timeout - VLERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s", "Payment validation failed - VLERR-4058: Invalid card number format", and "Stock sync failed - VLERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503".
The error codes observed in ERROR-level logs of payment-api-257 are VLERR-7291, VLERR-4058 and VLERR-9463 — one occurrence of each, no repeats within the returned entries.

The same stream also logged "Retrying database connection" at level=WARN and "Recovered from temporary outage" at level=INFO, alongside INFO entries "Service started successfully" and "Processing order batch complete".

The three VLERR codes point at three distinct failure surfaces named inside the messages (primary database connectivity, card-number validation, external inventory API returning 503); the evidence here is log text only and does not establish which of these affected payment-api-257's own request success rate or any caller.

The no_data view is not citable as fact.

Only 7 log entries exist in the whole window (streams listing returned a single stream), so nothing can be said about errors in other services, namespaces, or about ERROR logs that may have been dropped by retention or ingest delay.

No error-code enumeration or pattern search beyond the returned entries was performed (the full 7-entry stream was read, so nothing within that stream is unread), and no cross-check against traces or metrics was made to confirm whether these logged errors coincide with failed requests.
